definition: The Short Portable Mental Status Questionnaire is a brief questionnaire used to assess mental status and cognition. In the source, its score was used to classify cognitive impairment, with scores below 8 out of 10 counted as impaired.

reasons: The packet supports only that SPMSQ scores below 8/10 were used to define cognitive impairment in this study; it does not support the broader claim that the questionnaire is used to assess mental status and cognition.
